$comment: Environment variables this brick depends on. Read by `fonderie env`, the admin console and check:env-declarations — docs/ENV-DECLARATIONS-DESIGN.md

vars.name: NODE_ENV
vars.description: Runtime mode. production arms secure cookies and turns weak-secret warnings into boot errors.

vars.name: JWT_SECRET
vars.description: Signs session tokens. At least 32 characters, no placeholder words.

vars.name: MFA_SECRET_KEY
vars.description: Encrypts TOTP secrets at rest. Exactly 64 hex characters.

vars.name: PASSWORD_RESET_URL
vars.description: Link placed in password-reset emails. Unset: reset works by PIN only.

vars.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: OAuth client ID from Google Cloud Console.

vars.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: OAuth client secret from Google Cloud Console.

vars.name: GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
vars.description: Callback URL registered with Google, ending in /auth/oauth/google/callback.

vars.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
vars.description: ID of the Sign in with Apple key.

vars.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
vars.description: Contents of the .p8 key file, PEM with its BEGIN/END lines.

vars.name: APPLE_REDIRECT_URI
vars.description: Return URL registered for the Services ID.

vars.name: APPLE_NATIVE_CLIENT_IDS
vars.description: Bundle IDs of native apps allowed to sign in, comma-separated.

google.description: Sign in with Google — all or none (readiness GOOGLE_INCOMPLETE)

apple.description: Sign in with Apple — all or none (readiness APPLE_INCOMPLETE)
